words.meaning: A set of principles underlying and guiding the work of a particular artist or artistic movement, or the appreciation of beauty.
words.sentence1: The minimalist aesthetic of the gallery highlighted the subtle textures of each canvas.
words.sentence2: Her photography captures a haunting aesthetic that blends shadow and golden light.

words.meaning: Magnificence, brilliance, or supreme beauty and artistic glory.
words.sentence1: El esplendor de los frescos renacentistas dejo sin palabras a los visitantes. (The splendor of the Renaissance frescoes left visitors speechless.)
words.sentence2: Cada pincelada restaurada devolvio el esplendor original al retablo antiguo. (Each restored brushstroke returned the original splendor to the ancient altarpiece.)

words.meaning: Elegance or beauty of form, manner, motion, or artistic expression.
words.sentence1: La danseuse se deplacait avec une telle grace que la scene semblait flotter. (The dancer moved with such grace that the stage seemed to float.)
words.sentence2: Cette sculpture capture la grace naturelle du corps humain avec une grande finesse. (This sculpture captures the natural grace of the human body with great finesse.)

words.meaning: An aesthete or person devoted to the appreciation of art, beauty, and literature.
words.sentence1: Als wahrer Schoengeist verbrachte er seine Wochenenden in Kunstgalerien. (As a true aesthete, he spent his weekends in art galleries.)
words.sentence2: Ihr Wohnzimmer spiegelte den feinen Geschmack eines echten Schoengeistes wider. (Her living room reflected the refined taste of a true aesthete.)

words.meaning: A traditional Japanese aesthetic concept centered on finding beauty in imperfection, simplicity, and natural transience.
words.sentence1: Kono chawan no hibiware wa wabi-sabi no bi wo arawashite iru. (The cracks in this tea bowl express the beauty of wabi-sabi.)
words.sentence2: Kare wa koten-teki na teien ni yadoru wabi-sabi no kokoro wo e ni egaita. (He depicted the spirit of wabi-sabi dwelling in the classical garden in his painting.)

words.meaning: Masterpiece; an outstanding work of art, craft, or intellect exhibiting consummate skill.
words.sentence1: La statua scolpita nel marmo e considerata un autentico capolavoro della storia dell'arte. (The statue carved in marble is considered an authentic masterpiece of art history.)
words.sentence2: Il pittore dedico molti anni a rifinire quello che sarebbe diventato il suo capolavoro. (The painter dedicated many years to refining what would become his masterpiece.)

words.meaning: Aesthetic perception, aesthetic sense, or the refined appreciation of artistic beauty.
words.sentence1: Zhe fu shanshuihua chongman le gudian de meigan yu ningjing. (This landscape painting is full of classical aesthetic sense and tranquility.)
words.sentence2: Shejishi zai jianzhu zhong ronghe le xiandai meigan yu chuantong yuanlin de jingsui. (The designer integrated modern aesthetics with the essence of traditional gardens in the architecture.)

words.meaning: Beauty; aesthetic loveliness, elegance, and visual or spiritual grace.
words.sentence1: Geu misulgwan-eun gojeon hoehwa-ui areumdaum-eul jinjung-hage boyeojunda. (That art museum genuinely demonstrates the beauty of classical painting.)
words.sentence2: Jayeon-ui areumdaum-eun eonjena yesulga-deul-ege gipeun yeong-gam-eul junda. (The beauty of nature always gives artists deep inspiration.)

words.meaning: Beauty, loveliness, charm, or aesthetic radiance.
words.sentence1: Samross nai komnor boran nih thveu oy mneak mneak slap smoh. (The beauty of this ancient painting leaves everyone in awe.)
words.sentence2: Silpakor ban phtoch yok samross thommacheat mouk leu phtang komnor. (The artist captured the beauty of nature onto the canvas.)

words.meaning: A work of art or masterpiece created with artistic skill and aesthetic intent.
words.sentence1: Die pragtige beeldhouwerk word beskou as 'n uitsonderlike kunswerk. (The beautiful sculpture is regarded as an exceptional work of art.)
words.sentence2: Elke kunswerk in die galery vertel 'n unieke visuele verhaal. (Every work of art in the gallery tells a unique visual story.)
